notes.title: Multiplayer Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Dear friends, we are pleased to inform you that the beta version of PvP multiplayer is now available for play! 

[h2][url=https://imgur.com/a/YjbuO0R]Brief Guide For Multiplayer - https://imgur.com/a/YjbuO0R[/url][/h2]

We invite you and your friends to play, we will be glad to hear your feedback and your opinion on this update and the game in general, thank you![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43249810/d9a7e0daa21f9c931f6e4f4b5148c0364bbafc6a.png[/img]

[h2]Multiplayer mode can be found in the list of the main game modes[/h2]

notes.title: RELEASE of Trading Cards, Emoticons & BGs!
notes.notes:
[h3]Friends![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43249810/d9a7e0daa21f9c931f6e4f4b5148c0364bbafc6a.png[/img]
